name: Blessed Hunter’s Stride
body:
You can move through your territory with unmatched grace.

Prerequisite: Blessed Hunter.

Benefit: Your movement speed increases by 10 feet while in your chosen territory. In addition, you ignore the effects of non-magical difficult terrain while in your chosen territory.
